jobs.title: Domain Architect (Technology Integration Management Office)
jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods , we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams.  We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.
If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:
The Domain Architect – TIMO is responsible for creating, governing, and evolving target-state architecture models and integration designs that enable enterprise integration across DICK'S Sporting Goods and Foot Locker. This role interprets, applies, and maintains technology architecture and its component models to guide business transformation initiatives, ensuring solutions balance value, cost, speed, and risk.
Operating within the Technology Integration Management Office (TIMO), the Domain Architect establishes and educates the organization on architectural process and standards, applying architecture standards and blueprint priorities across scoping, discovery, design, and transition phases. The role also leads and develops Solution Architects embedded within Business Capability Enablement teams, driving consistent architectural practices and quality across ERP, Supply Chain, Digital, Data, and HCM domains.
Success in this role requires strong business and technology acumen, the ability to influence executive, business, and technical stakeholders, and sound judgment in balancing competing priorities across complex, cross-functional integration initiatives. The Domain Architect plays a critical part in ensuring the enterprise integration blueprint is realized and that architectural decisions support long-term value realization objectives.

STRATEGIC DESIGN
- Develop and maintain target-state architecture blueprints across business processes, data, applications, and platforms.
- Model and assess current-state architectures and define transition states aligned to integration priorities.
- Recommend and participate in the development of integration patterns, architecture standards, and design guardrails.
- Research and evaluate technology solutions to meet business capability and integration requirements.
- Advise leadership on architecture strategies, methodologies, and long-term design direction.
- Align architecture with enterprise strategy, product roadmaps, and integration blueprint objectives.
- Identify opportunities for proof-of-concepts and participate in validating new architectural approaches.
- Define architecture artifacts and documentation standards to support consistency and governance.

STRATEGIC IMPLEMENTATION
- Participate in cross-functional design sessions and working teams for integration initiatives.
- Develop solution architectures, models, and transition plans to support discovery and design phases.
- Identify implementation risks and assess impacts to business operations, timelines, and outcomes.
- Ensure architected solutions are implemented in accordance with established standards and principles.
- Analyze the impact of systems, data, and process changes on enterprise operations and performance.
- Partner with product, engineering, and portfolio teams to translate architecture into executable plans.

GOVERNANCE
- Lead activities related to maintaining integration architecture and design consistency across initiatives.
- Review solution designs to ensure conformance with architecture standards, policies, and roadmaps.
- Provide cross-program architectural governance, identifying risks, duplications, or misalignment.
- Recommend architecture standards, tools, and methodologies to strengthen governance processes.
- Support escalation and decision-making for complex or high-risk architectural challenges.
- Ensure alignment across key domains (ERP, Supply Chain, Digital, Data, HCM) to avoid fragmentation.

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & EDUCATION
- Lead, coach, and develop Solution Architects embedded in Business Capability Enablement teams.
- Share best practices, lessons learned, and evolving architectural standards across the organization.
- Promote architecture principles and benefits to build organizational understanding and alignment.
- Allocate architectural resources in alignment with portfolio priorities and sequencing.
- Provide guidance on architecture processes, governance, and quality expectations.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline (additional experience considered in lieu of degree)
- 10-15 total years experience
- Experience as a domain or enterprise architect leading large-scale technology transformation or integration programs (e.g., mergers/acquisitions, retail eCommerce platforms)
- Experience designing solutions across enterprise platforms (ERP, IMS, OMS, Data, Digital)
- Experience influencing executive, business, and technical stakeholders
- Experience managing or leading architecture teams or practices
- Retail experience a plus

jobs.description:
At DICK’S Sporting Goods , we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams.  We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.
If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:
Sport inspires us.  Innovation drives us. Come Win With Us at DICK’S Sporting Goods as part of a team that redefines what’s possible.

Whether you live for sport or cozy fashion, you’ll love building your career at DICK’S. It’s more than a job — it’s a chance to be part of a team where you’re welcomed, supported, and empowered from day one. In our stores, you’ll make a real difference by delivering exceptional experiences to athletes of all abilities. If you’re coachable, accountable, collaborative, and trustworthy, this is the place for you. Win with us every time you step onto the floor.

​ As an Assistant Store Manager of Operations , you will lead operational execution in a fast-paced retail environment focused on efficiency, accuracy, and a seamless athlete experience. You will coach and develop teammates, optimize processes, and ensure the store runs at a high level across both front and back-of-house operations. Join a team that values teamwork, discipline, and continuous improvement.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

- Collaborates with the Store Manager to contribute to developing and executing full-year business growth plans, including forecasting and planning 90+ days out. Ensures operational strategies support long-term success and work to identify opportunities in the store and validate key programs/processes (e.g., BOPIS, ship-from-store, etc.)
- Directly manages a team of Captains (Supervisors) and indirectly manages broader store team through influence, coaching, and development. Equips leaders to lead others effectively and fosters a high-performing, inclusive team environment. Accountable for performance management, including development, annual reviews, and promotional recommendations for the Captain (Supervisor) team, and for holding all teammates accountable for compliance with policies and procedures, including disciplinary and termination recommendations.
- Upholds company merchandising and presentation standards by ensuring compliant execution of established floor sets, signage requirements, price changes, inventory presentation, replenishment standards, etc. Promotes, drives, and leads company programs (i.e., customer loyalty program participation, warranty sales, private label credit card enrollment, etc.). Acts as a role model for service, selling, and leadership behaviors that elevate the athlete experience. Models outstanding athlete experiences by anticipating athlete needs and providing clear, accurate, and knowledgeable information about products and assortment.
- Demonstrates the ability to lead, execute and validate key training initiatives (including cross-training leaders of others). Accountable for ensuring all teammates are trained/equipped to deliver elevated athlete experiences; focuses on accountability through motivation, hands-on coaching, regular exposure, and stretch assignments; builds development plans in partnership with teammates.
- Partners with Store Manager on long-range management of the store workforce and approves Captain (Supervisor) staffing plans. Oversees payroll and staff scheduling to align with budget goals and adapt to athlete traffic and sales trends, ensuring workforce flexibility and schedule effectiveness.
- Hires and builds strong teams by partnering closely with the Store Manager and Captain (Supervisor) team to create targeted hiring strategies to actively source, recruit, and interview potential teammates. Owns hiring decisions for the Captain (Supervisor) population and is accountable for hiring and termination decisions for the hourly population, based on Captain (Supervisor) recommendations. Coaches Captain (Supervisors) on effective interviewing, hiring, and team-building practices.
- Holds teammates accountable for meeting established operational guidelines, brand standards, customer service expectations and company policies. Ensures store safety, standards, and operational procedures are upheld. Creates a store environment where everyone, both teammates and athletes, are always welcome and treated with respect. Adheres to and enforce established policies and procedures related to safety, loss prevention and standard operating procedures, as well as to laws/guidelines of external governing entities. Hold teammates who fail to meet or comply with expectations accountable.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- High School Diploma or Equivalent

- 1-3 years experience

- 1-3 of retail management experience (or customer-focused experience)

OVERVIEW:
The Manager, Trade Compliance is responsible for the day-to-day management and continuous improvement of the DICK’S Sporting Goods Trade Compliance program. This position oversees customs brokerage operations, Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) compliance, process and policy development, trade compliance team development and managing the alignment processes and integration of Foot Locker and the Dick’s Sporting Goods trade programs. The role serves as a key business partner across Supply Chain, Sourcing, Merchandising, Finance, Legal and external service providers to ensure compliance with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) regulations and international trade laws while identifying opportunities for operational efficiency, cost savings and risk reduction.

This position drives strategic initiatives that strengthen the Company's trade compliance framework, enhance regulatory compliance and support business growth.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Program Management & Compliance Operations:
- Manage the Company's trade compliance operations, including customs brokerage, FTZ administration, customs valuation and regulatory compliance activities
- Ensure compliance with CBP regulations, FTZ requirements and applicable international trade laws
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen compliance controls, reduce risk exposure and improve operational efficiency
- Evaluate business impacts of dynamic tariff environment and provide recommendations for reducing exposure
- Identify and implement savings opportunities through duty reduction strategies and process enhancements
- Obtain and maintain adequate customs bonds to support direct import and FTZ operations
- Supervise FTZ compliance and administration activities for Company FTZ operations
- Monitor compliance performance metrics and develop reporting for senior leadership
- Communicate compliance risks, audit findings and remediation plans to management
- Serve as a subject matter expert on trade compliance implications for sourcing decisions, new product launches and special business initiatives

Develop Process and Policies to Reduce Risk and Enable Scalable Growth:
- Develop, document, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), policies and compliance workflows
- Evaluate new business projects and opportunities and develop business assimilation plans to incorporate them into workflows
- Evaluate existing processes and implement enhancements that improve compliance, efficiency and accountability
- Lead cross-functional process improvement initiatives related to import compliance and customs operations
- Ensure compliance requirements are effectively embedded within business processes and systems

Vendor and Service Provider Management:
- Manage relationships with customs brokers, consultants, SaaS providers and technology service providers
- Establish performance expectations, monitor service levels and ensure adherence to contractual obligations and SLAs
- Conduct regular business reviews and performance evaluations with service providers
- Partner with Sourcing to execute RFI and RFQ processes for compliance-related services
- Negotiate service rates, scopes of work and operational requirements
- Collaborate with Legal to review service agreements and resolve contractual issues
- Escalate and resolve systemic, procedural and compliance-related concerns with providers as needed

Lead and Develop Teammates:
- Lead, mentor and develop a team of Trade Compliance Analysts
- Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations and accountability measures
- Provide regular guidance, coaching and workload prioritization
- Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration and professional development
- Conduct performance reviews and create development plans to strengthen team capabilities
- Ensure internal associates and external service providers receive appropriate training on Company trade compliance requirements

- Knowledge of customs valuation methodologies
